rv.q: Sorry for Your Loss is a very funny comedy on a serious subject.
The production offers a moving and comforting vision of the departed among us.
Sorry for Your Loss is a great opportunity to get to know his unique voice, and to laugh in the face of death even while recognizing that it will come for us all.
The 75-minute show, the latest stage production from Audible Theater, provides a lesson on how to navigate grief and offer support beyond platitudes.

Kayne’s monologue—it’s hard to call it a “play”—at least allows us to agree that there are no simple solutions to handling grief, or commenting on it, while at the same time offering the opportunity to laugh at the dilemma.
This is a stunningly beautiful heartfelt evening of endearing, hilarious, educational (there are Math and English instructions), and heartfelt stories of Kayne’s family and their loss.
Sorry For Your Loss is that rare thing – smart, funny, warm, moving and only 75 minutes long.
Whatever emotions may surface as you listen and watch this seventy-minute monologue, one sure thing is that you will leave the theatre inspired and uplifted.

cn.t: Kayne's theatrical debut blends stand-up comedy with poignant storytelling about grief and loss, earning praise for its hilarious yet moving examination of tragedy. Critics applaud the show's ability to balance humor with heartfelt emotion.
